title: Sprint 1 — Project Foundation & Database Models
description: Set up the Spring Boot application and implement relational JPA database entities for Users and Tasks.

learning_objectives: Understand Spring Boot application entrypoint and auto-configuration.
Learn how to configure database connection strings in application.properties.
Implement and verify basic REST controller JSON endpoints.
tickets.title: Ticket 1 - Initialize Spring Boot Application & Health Check
tickets.description:
Initialize the Spring Boot application using @SpringBootApplication in TodoApplication.java. Configure the SQLite database connection and establish a baseline health check endpoint.

### Requirements
1. In TodoApplication.java, implement public static void main(String[] args) invoking SpringApplication.run(TodoApplication.class, args).
2. In pplication.properties, configure spring.datasource.url=jdbc:sqlite:todo.db with SQLite driver and dialect.
3. Register a health check route GET /api/health that returns JSON {"status": "healthy"} with HTTP 200 OK.
4. Ensure the application runs on port 5000.
common_mistakes: Returning plain text or HTML instead of ResponseEntity or JSON Map.
Hardcoding configuration inside controllers instead of application.properties.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 - Design and Implement User Entity
tickets.description:
Create the User JPA entity in src/main/java/com/yuvro/todo/entity/User.java. Ensure passwords are never stored in plain text by integrating password encryption.

### Entity Specifications: users Table
- id: Long, primary key, @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY).
- username: String (max 80), unique, non-nullable.
- email: String (max 120), unique, non-nullable.
- password_hash: String (max 255), non-nullable.
- created_at: LocalDateTime.

### Helper Methods
- 	oDict(): Returns a Map representation of user info excluding password_hash.
common_mistakes: Storing plain text passwords in the database.
Including password_hash in the 	oDict() output map.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 - Design Task Entity with User Relationship
tickets.description:
Implement the Task entity in src/main/java/com/yuvro/todo/entity/Task.java and link it to the User entity via a foreign key relationship.

### Entity Specifications: 	asks Table
- id: Long, primary key, auto-incrementing.
- user: User, @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY) with @JoinColumn(name = "user_id", nullable = false).
- 	itle: String (max 200), non-nullable.
- description: String (TEXT), nullable.
- is_completed: Boolean, default  alse, non-nullable.
- created_at: LocalDateTime.
- updated_at: LocalDateTime.

### Helper Methods
- 	oDict(): Returns a Map representation of the task (id, user_id, 	itle, description, is_completed, created_at, updated_at).
common_mistakes: Forgetting to set is_completed default value to  alse.
